title: Crossing the Continental Divide
text: In central McKinley County, Interstate 40 crosses the Continental Divide at Campbell Pass, 7,275 feet up. Signs in the median mark the spot, and state historic markers stand on the service roads on each side. Starting in 1926, this pass also carried Route 66, and remnants of the old roadside are still around. A small community called Continental Divide sits at the pass, about 25 miles east-southeast of Gallup.

s3.title: Continental Divide, New Mexico
s3.quote: Continental Divide is an unincorporated community and census-designated place (CDP) in McKinley County ... The community is located in central McKinley County along Interstate 40, 25 miles (40 km) east-southeast of Gallup ... at Campbell Pass, a low point along the Continental Divide of the Americas
